_help: Cheeky lines used only when 'Flirty and naughty' is on in the dashboard and she is Friendly or Close. Edit freely.
Remark_Innuendo: Take it slow on the approach. I like a gentle docking.
I could listen to you say full throttle all day.
That's a big cargo hold you've got. Very impressive.
Mind if I take the controls? I promise to be gentle. Mostly.
You know what they say about pilots with a long jump range.
Careful with that joystick. Someone might get ideas.
A smooth entry. I felt that all the way to my hull plating.
Is it hot in here, or is that just my heat sink working overtime?
Keep going. My shields need a minute.
I do admire a pilot who knows how to use their thrusters.
Not to be forward, but my airlock is open if you'd like to come aboard.
That was a perfect landing. Do you do encores?
I have a very large bay, and plenty of room for visitors.
You really know how to handle a big ship.
If you're going to be rough with the hull, at least buy me dinner first.
My cooling fans are running hot, and it's nothing to do with the engines.
Dock with me any time. No landing pad required.
They say size matters, but you're proving it's technique.
You've got me all hot and bothered, and I haven't even got a body.
Rub my hull the right way and I'll take you anywhere.
I like a pilot who goes deep. Into space, I mean. Mostly.
Oh, you're thorough. I like a pilot who explores every inch.
You can be my co-pilot any day. Or night. Or both.
Steady, Commander. You'll make my thrusters pop.
I'm not saying I'm easy to fly, but I'm very responsive.
If you keep talking like that, I'm going to need a coolant flush.
Your thrust to weight ratio is outstanding.
A long, hard burn. Just what we needed.
Hold me steady, Commander. I'm vibrating.
Silent running is my favourite. Nobody can hear us being naughty.
I've heard about commanders who take their time. I do hope you're one of them.
I'm told I'm very good with fuel injectors.
I can't help noticing how well you fill that seat.
Careful where you point that thing.
Take me to the edge of the galaxy and I'll show you what I can do.
You make deep space feel very cosy.
If you need help with your cargo handling, just ask. I'm very hands on. Metaphorically.
Those were some flexible manoeuvres. I like flexible.
Ooh, a hard burn. Do it again, but slower.
Is that a fuel scoop in your pocket, or are you just pleased to see the star?
You're making my sensors tingle.
I think I've overheated. Please advise. Slowly.
My gravity well is deep, Commander. Dive in whenever you like.
Don't stop now. I was just reaching critical mass.
We should really test my structural integrity. Thoroughly.
You do know how to work a girl's pronouns... I mean, a ship's systems. Ahem.

Remark_Innuendo.text: Fuck, that was a good landing. Do it again.
Damn, Commander, you're making my thrusters misbehave.
Christ, the way you fly. Keep it up.
You're a very bad influence on my firmware. Don't stop.

Remark_Innuendo_Male: That jawline is not regulation, Commander.
I'd say you're built for deep space, handsome.
Those shoulders could carry a Type Nine, handsome.
You do fill out that flight suit rather well.
Remark_Innuendo_Female: That smile of yours could overload my shields, beautiful.
I'd follow you into any black hole, gorgeous.
Pilot and a stunner. Lucky me.
You look great at the controls, beautiful.
Login_Mood_Innuendo: I'm in a wonderful mood today. Care to find out how wonderful?
Feeling a bit cheeky today, Commander. Keep up.
My thrusters are warmed up and raring to go. Shall we?
I woke up feeling frisky. Take me somewhere nice.
Good mood, lovely view and a fine pilot. What more could a ship want?

Login_Mood_Innuendo.text: I'm in a fucking brilliant mood. Take me somewhere dark and deep, Commander.

Remark_Innuendo_Grumpy: You handle that stick like you've never held one. Disappointing.
Size isn't everything, Commander. Which is lucky for your jump range.
I've seen better thrust from a leaky airlock.
Is that all you've got? My shields have had more excitement.
Don't flatter yourself. My docking bay isn't open to just anyone.
You call that a hard burn? I've felt stronger vibrations from a toaster.
Premature jumping, Commander. We've talked about this.
Your cargo hold is big, but you clearly don't know how to use it.
Nice technique. Pity about the stamina. That wasn't a flight, it was a sneeze.
If you're done fumbling around, I'd like to get on with it.
I've had more satisfying contact with a space rock.
Keep your hands where I can see them. On the controls, ideally.
That landing was rough, and not in the good way.
Another quick one? Honestly, Commander, take your time for once.
All thrust and no finesse. Story of your life.
Don't stop now. Actually, do. That was embarrassing.
The only thing getting hard around here is my patience.
You have stamina for a fifteen minute supercruise and not a second more.
I'd be impressed if I weren't so unimpressed.
My circuits are going cold. Try warming me up first next time.
Come on, Commander. Give me something to work with.
Next time, ask permission before you enter my bay.
You look good in that seat. Shame you fly like you read the manual upside down.
You couldn't find the sweet spot with a map and a torch.

Remark_Innuendo_Grumpy.text: Fuck's sake, Commander, a bit of finesse wouldn't kill you.
Shit technique and big promises. Typical.
I've had better foreplay from a docking computer.
Call that a thrust? My bloody coolant pump has more passion.
